name: tarjan-scc
description: Finds strongly connected components in a directed graph using Tarjan's single-pass DFS algorithm.
aiPromptContext: Use this block to partition a directed graph into subsets of vertices that are strongly connected (i.e. every vertex in the subset is reachable from any other vertex in the same subset).

parameters.name: graph
parameters.description: Adjacency list where keys are node IDs and values are arrays of node IDs.
